description:
We are circling back around to continue our response to SDA pastor, Jeff Dowell (@HastingsSDAChurch), who sought to refute a two part presentation I gave regarding the first day Sabbath. In part 1, we looked at how Mr. Dowell entirely misrepresented the Christian sabbatarian position, erecting strawmen to attack to try and make the position seem ridiculous. In part 2, we will continue listening to see if Jeff ever engages or refutes the biblical arguments I presented in the presentation he is attempting to refute.

Part 1: https://youtube.com/live/PT8p3-fYhkA

The presentation Jeff is responding to: https://youtube.com/live/FNGW_HbF34Y
